closed_children.title: Terminal compaction stub + no-ff merge back
Gate: docs up to date (v0.2 epic)

description:
Milestone per ARCHITECTURE.md §12.

Success criterion (quoted): An exchange is a branch, completion is a no-ff merge back to main, the repo layout matches §2.2. User message → exchange branch → steps as linear commits → compactor (deletion-only, stub is fine) → merge. Unmerged branch count metric available.

=== Scope ===
- ex/<ts>-<id> branches off main per exchange.
- goal.md written at spawn (§2.8).
- Step-as-linear-commit with commit-before-model-call (§2.3, §2.10). v0.2 has no tools, so one exchange = one step = one step commit.
- Terminal compactor subagent; deletion-only; stub acceptable.
- Merge protocol (§2.6): rebase onto parent tip, --no-ff merge.
- branches.json kept honest; unmerged-count surface available.
- v0.1 exceptions retired: direct-to-main commit (naturally falls out of the branch flow) and --endpoint forwarding (restore strict §4.4).

=== Explicit non-goals ===
- Tools (v0.3).
- Invocations / subagent dispatch for worker (v0.4) — the compactor is the one permitted exception because §2.7 defines it as a subagent.
- UI (v0.5).
- workflow.yaml-driven flows (v0.6).

=== Done-when ===
End-to-end:
  lernie new /tmp/c
  lernie prompt /tmp/c 'hello'
produces: an ex/<ts>-<id> branch that compacts, no-ff merges to main, with the exchange visible in main's history as a merge commit. branches.json is empty again after merge.
